comments.body: Ken Williams! Creator of Sierra! They dominated the entire PC market from the late 70s to early 90s and created many firsts. This guy knows game development better than all of us combined. Hell Sierra made it onto the stock exchange n sold out for nearly 1 billion dollars in 1996! Now he n Roberta sail the world on their exotic boat. Who can deny Kings Quest, Space Quest, Quest for glory, Police Quest, Leisure suit Larry n so many more. He has embraced AI and made his latest game/simulator called NAV SIM ACADEMY fully with ai without ever looking at the code and is selling it for 99 dollars. If you are not into boating you won't care or get it. The point is even he agrees ai is here n can do more than any single human or even team could achieve. (However if you don't know nothing about nothing your ai will suck, if you are a competent coder this will become your ultimate tool if you know how to control it) Yes ai art makes so many mistakes and honestly ai music sucks... But give it 5 years... I believe it will outperform the majority of people. You can either embrace the inevitable future or you can drown in the tsunami! In the same way the lightbulb killed the candle pretty much or the car derailed the horse industry or CDs kicked VHS this is happening whether we like it or not. Which side will you choose in the coming years?
